transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the daily disposition huddle started. We've got 900 aluminum blanks held in Cell 2 due to mixed labels from two drawing revisions. Production is paused until we get a disposition plan approved. Before I record the plan, I need findings from each of you. Let's start with quality -- what have you found regarding the mixed labeling issue?

transcript.text: I completed a piece-by-piece traceability audit this morning. Here's what I found: exactly 640 blanks can be positively matched to revision C and pass the dimensional screen, while exactly 260 cannot be matched to a revision and must be scrapped under the traceability procedure. I should note I haven't uploaded the audit to the shared quality system yet, but these are the verified numbers.
